title: History Detective
desc: Your shell remembers everything. Rerun old commands without retyping them.

levels.title: Once more
levels.brief: The docs server crashed. Start it again.
levels.tip: Ctrl+P (or ↑) brings back the previous command. Enter runs it.

levels.title: Scroll back
levels.brief: Did the docs build? List the docs folder again.
levels.tip: Each Ctrl+P goes one command further back. Ctrl+N comes forward again if you overshoot.

levels.title: Needle
levels.brief: The database container is gone. Start it exactly like this morning.
levels.tip: Ctrl+R searches back through history as you type. A few distinctive letters are enough. Ctrl+G cancels.

levels.title: Not that one
levels.brief: Log in to the staging server. (You were on prod more recently.)
levels.tip: Ctrl+R finds the newest match first. Press Ctrl+R again to jump to the next older one.

levels.title: Permission denied
levels.brief: apt install failed: you forgot sudo.
levels.tip: !! stands for the whole previous command, so sudo !! reruns it with sudo. Bash swaps it in when you press Enter.

levels.title: Follow me
levels.brief: You just made a directory. Go into it.
levels.tip: Alt+. pastes the last argument of the previous command right now. Typing !$ does the same, but only when you press Enter.

levels.title: By name
levels.brief: Something is eating the CPU. Open the process monitor again.
levels.tip: !h reruns the newest command that starts with h. Type just enough letters to pick the right one.

levels.title: Number 13
levels.brief: Your teammate read your `history` and says: "run 13 again".
levels.tip: Every command has a number (run `history` to see them). !13 reruns number 13.

levels.title: Wrong service
levels.brief: Those were the api logs. You wanted the web deployment.
levels.tip: ^api^web reruns the last command with the first api replaced by web.

levels.title: To production
levels.brief: The demo video went to staging. Send it to prod instead.
levels.tip: Search lands the cursor on what you searched for, and editing keys work straight away. Search for the part you want to change.

levels.title: The detective
levels.brief: After the rebase, push the coupons branch again the way you did before.
levels.tip: Pick whichever trick is shortest: arrows, search, or a bang.
